title: Call Your Friends│呼朋引伴
description: Use your goat horns to call your animal friends.│使用山羊角來呼喚你的動物朋友。
body:
# Function│功能
- When a named goat horn is played, all mobs with the same custom name as the goat horn and whose owner is the player will be teleported to the player's location, up to a maximum of 10 mobs.│吹奏一個命名過的山羊角時，所有與山羊角自訂名稱相同且主人是吹奏者的生物都會被傳送到吹奏者的位置，最多傳送10個生物。
